qualification.details: Educational Qualification: MBBS degree with a Post Graduate Degree/Diploma from an NMC-recognized institution in the concerned specialty. Specialties (Advt. 2755, Non-Teaching SMO): Anesthesia, Dermatology, ENT, Forensic Science, Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Ophthalmology, Orthopedics, Pediatrics, Pathology, Medicine, Psychiatry, Radiology and Surgery. Specialties (Advt. 2750, NHM SMO): Anesthesia, Dermatology, ENT, Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Ophthalmology, Orthopedics, General Medicine, Psychiatry, Radiology and Surgery. Registration: The candidate must possess valid registration with the appropriate Medical Council, as required in the online application. Experience: Not mandatory, but greater relevant experience is used as a tie-break criterion in selection.

salary_details.pay_scale: Bid-based monthly remuneration, maximum Rs. 3,00,000/- per month (plus incentive on health insurance claims)
salary_details.details: Maximum Bid: Candidates quote the monthly remuneration separately for each selected facility, and the quoted amount shall not exceed Rs. 3,00,000/- per month. Fixed Monthly Emoluments: The SMO is paid fixed monthly emoluments as prescribed under the terms of engagement. Incentive: In addition, the SMO is entitled to an incentive against the health insurance claims generated and settled through services rendered by him/her, as per Government Sankalp No. 58(21) dated 11-04-2025, as amended from time to time. Accommodation: Where Government accommodation is available, the selected SMO shall reside there. Otherwise, the officer shall ordinarily reside within a radius of 3 km from the District Hospital. The engagement is purely contractual and does not confer any claim for regular appointment, absorption, seniority or other service benefits applicable to regular Government employees.

including negotiation at the L-1 rate wherever applicable. If the selected L-1 bidder does not join the allotted facility within 30 days

the first L2 bidder whose reserved category quota is not fulfilled is given an opportunity to serve at the amount determined by the L1 bidder. If the quota cannot be filled from L2

The engagement is purely contractual and continues only until a regular Specialist Medical Officer is posted against the concerned facility/post. An agreement may initially be executed for three years

how_to_apply: Eligible candidates can apply for Jharkhand NHM Specialist Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 through online mode only, between 08-10-2026 and 31-10-2026. Follow the steps below:
Visit the Jharkhand recruitment portal, www.recruitment.jharkhand.gov.in, and read the advertisement and instructions carefully (details are also available at www.jrhms.jharkhand.gov.in).

Fill in the online application, including candidate details (name, gender, date of birth, category, mobile number, e-mail ID, Medical Council registration number and issuing date), address details, educational qualifications and experience. Fields marked with an asterisk (*) are mandatory.
Select the facilities you are applying for (maximum three) and quote the monthly remuneration for each facility, not exceeding Rs. 3,00,000/-.

Upload the documents: recent passport-size photograph, signature, 10th and 12th mark sheets and certificates, complete educational qualification documents, experience certificates (currently employed candidates may upload the appointment letter and last three months' salary certificate/bank statement), caste certificate issued by the competent authority of the Government of Jharkhand (if applicable), disability certificate (if applicable), Medical Council Registration Certificate, and the undertaking regarding present employment/non-employment.
Pay the application fee, if prescribed in the portal, and submit the application. The application is successfully submitted only when the portal displays the status "Submitted Successfully".
Incomplete, defective or partially filled applications are liable to be rejected.
A candidate must not submit more than one application for the same post. Multiple/duplicate applications may lead to cancellation of candidature.
Requests for change/correction after final submission are not ordinarily entertained.
Canvassing or attempting to influence the selection in any manner makes the candidature liable to rejection.
Candidates should regularly check the official websites for corrigenda, notices and further instructions.
